caption: The video captures an elevated night view over a valley blanketed in illuminated fog. A dark forested ridge silhouettes the lower foreground beneath a deep purple sky. Scattered city lights glow faintly through the mist, while a bright pink-white patch of lit cloud and an orange-lit band sit in the middle distance. The fog layer is already in slow motion as the excerpt opens, its glowing surface continuously reshaping and brightening. The central pink-white glow broadens and softens, losing its sharp edges, while the orange band on the left widens and blends into the surrounding mist. As the mist density fluctuates, individual lights are alternately veiled and revealed, and the brightest region drifts subtly left of center. The foreground ridge and the distant horizon lights remain fixed, anchoring the scene as the luminous cloud mass churns gently throughout the visible portion.
